csv_scope_of_work: The City of Coalinga ( City ) is soliciting Statements of Qualifications ( SOQ ) from qualified aviation consulting firms or independent aviation professionals to provide Airport Management & Compliance Consulting Services for the City of Coalinga Municipal Airport. The City of Coalinga is seeking qualified aviation consultants to provide comprehensive airport management and regulatory compliance services for the New Coalinga Municipal Airport. The selected consultant will serve as the City s contracted Airport Manager and primary aviation operations advisor, assisting the City in maintaining compliance with Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) requirements, Airport Improvement Program (AIP) grant assurances, California Division of Aeronautics requirements, and general airport operational responsibilities.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Transportation Planning
